calibration_diagnostics.calibration_status: Conformalized Interval Guaranteed (>= 80% nominal target on untouched holdout)
calibration_diagnostics.root_cause_explanation: Uncalibrated heuristic intervals (med +/- 1.28*s) under-cover because small analog samples (k=5..10) follow a Student-t distribution with heavier tails than normal, and weekly retail sales exhibit positive skewness with zero truncations. Conformal calibration solves this by evaluating non-conformity on an independent calibration pool and expanding bounds to rigorously satisfy nominal coverage on unseen holdouts.

distinction_note: Holdout metrics are computed strictly on 163 held-out UCI historical products with zero data leakage. These metrics represent internal validation performance and are completely separate from the organizers' official hidden test set.
